_note: 効果音の台本 (2026-11 に作り直し、同日に音量を ラウドネス基準に変更)。prompt は ElevenLabs Sound Effects への指示 (英語)。duration は秒 (0.5 から 30)。target は、鳴っている部分の RMS の目標 (dBFS)。mix.mjs が各音をこの値にそろえ (ピークは -3 dB まで)、cue_map の gain (dB) をそのきっかけだけの上げ下げとして足す。cue 名は render.mjs が書く cues.json のもの。映像の言語に依らず 1 セットを ja・en の両方に使う。 効果音は、ここぞという所 (cue_map に残したきっかけ) だけにつける。only は、同じ名前のきっかけの何番目 (1 から) にだけ音をつけるか。

whoosh.prompt: A quick soft air whoosh of a light card sliding fast across a room, clean, dry, no music, no voice

burst.prompt: Six small soft pops bursting outward at once, gentle bubble and plastic taps, bright and clean, no music

tick.prompt: A clear short wooden click, like tapping a wooden block once with a fingernail, dry, audible, no reverb

tap.prompt: A tiny bright glassy tap with a short soft tail, like touching a small bell, dry and clean

logo.prompt: A warm soft chime logo sting, two gentle notes with an airy shimmer tail, calm and modern, no voice

throw.prompt: A short light whoosh of a card being flicked through the air, fast and soft

land.prompt: A soft magnetic click as a flat object settles into place, small muted thud with a tiny snap, dry

key.prompt: A single laptop keyboard key press, soft and quiet, short

overlay.prompt: A soft airy swell as a translucent overlay fades in, subtle, clean, short

cell.prompt: A tiny crisp mechanical click, like a single detent step of a rotary dial, short, dry and clearly audible, no reverb

confirm.prompt: A soft positive confirmation tap with a tiny rising tone, short and clean

arrange.prompt: Four quick soft whooshes in a row, like cards sliding into a neat grid, followed by soft clicks, clean

nudge.prompt: A flat card sliding a short way and stopping softly against another card, a gentle dry tap at the end

monitor.prompt: A smooth soft whoosh sweeping from left to right as a card glides to another screen, with a gentle landing tap

toggle.prompt: A small crisp switch toggle click, like a light plastic slider flipping, dry and clean

restore.prompt: A soft reassuring two-note chime going down then settling, like something being put back in place, calm and short

save.prompt: A soft tidy save ding, a short bright tap with a small clean tail, like a file being stored, no voice
